excerpt: Owners can now form an LLC, open a business bank account, and see where their money stands in Gusto, before they hire anyone.
State Tax Registration — Registers a business with state and local agencies such as the Department of Revenue and Department of Labor to establish required tax accounts when hiring in a new state
Government Mail Monitoring — Tracks and resolves official compliance mail from state and local agencies, tax notices, and tax rate changes, directly within Gusto
Proactive Compliance Alerts — Notifies customers of upcoming compliance deadlines and new obligations, including annual reports, as well as annual tax reminders
Annual Report — Files the annual report required by states to maintain a business's good standing with the Secretary of State
